messages:
Mina: quick async — morning pulse on API GW / routing policies / auth / rate limits. Do a 1-2 line what I did / blocker / today please. TL;DR: saw a tiny 429 blip during the 08:30 deploy window, digging.

Kevin: What I did: rolled out token-cache TTL tweak to reduce K/V churn on edge (PR linked). Observed ~0.3% 429 increase during canary at ~08:28.
Blocker: can't repro locally — only in canary.
Today: will sweep logs, add more metrics to the auth proxy.

Anya: What I did: looked at routing policy shard config and noticed policy fallback for service-x had a lower burst limit (500 -> 300).
Blocker: not sure if fallback + short TTL combo caused token refresh storms.
Today: will run a synthetic load against canary and post results.

Kevin: logs snippet from the canary node (truncated):
```
2025-11-12T08:28:12Z auth-proxy[pid=1245] WARN ratelimit=429 route=/v1/generate user=svc-x tokens=0 ttl_ms=1200
2025-11-12T08:28:13Z auth-proxy[pid=1245] INFO token-cache miss user=svc-x key=abc123
```

Mina: thanks. My read: small TTL + lower burst + short token-cache leads to more auth calls, which can tip the ratelimiter briefly. Not systemic but noisy.

deploy-bot: Deployment 2025-11-12-08:25 by kevin -> canary (3/3 healthy). Rollback available. :white_check_mark:

Tara: What I did: quick review of Kevin's PR (LGTM except minor test flake).
Blocker: none.
Today: will approve + merge once we confirm no regression on synthetic.

Mina: proposed mitigation plan:
- short-term: bump service-x burst to 600 in canary and re-run synthetic for 30m.
- medium: increase token-cache TTL from 1.2s -> 6s for svc accounts (keeps memory ok but reduces churn).
- long-term: add token-refresh histogram + per-route token-cache hit rate to console.
I can apply the short-term burst bump if everyone ok.

Anya: +1 for the burst bump, will run synthetic after. Please add a note to the runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gw-auth-throttle (update: add token-ttl example).

Kevin: I'm +1. I'll hold the PR merge until we validate synthetic. If synthetic looks healthy I'll merge and promote canary.

Mina: action items summarized:
- Kevin: hold PR, run synthetic, post results (ETA ~20m).
- Anya: synthetic load results + check other fallback policies.
- Tara: merge after green synthetic + r+ on PR.
- Mina: bump canary burst to 600 and monitor for 1h; if no regressions, promote.

Mina: ping if anything interesting; otherwise we'll reconvene in end-of-day async summary. :thumbsup:
